title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Parents at practice
hook: Where do parents sit during your practices?
intro: A few call out tips to their own kids.
statement: Practice works best when kids have room to try and miss.
q1: Do you invite parents to watch from a distance —
q2: or put them to work running a station?
q3: How do kids play when parents are close by?
t1: Both can work. But kids relax
t2: when practice feels like their space.
cta: Coaches — where do parents go at practice?
ctaLines: Watch from the car. Help at a station. Drop and go.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Where do parents sit during your practices?
Five parents line the fence. A few call out tips to their own kids.
Practice works best when kids have room to try and miss.
Watch from a distance or help out. Both can work.
Where do parents go at practice? Share your habit in the comments.
